title: Walk to Downtown, Big Yard, Stylish
description:
Perfect layout for large groups who still want their space and privacy from each other with 2900 sq ft! The upstairs has the option of its own entrance. 2 kitchens. 2 dining rooms. Plenty of private parking and huge fenced in back yard. 

please note: the internal staircase is very steep. There is an option of an external staircase and we do not recommend anyone with mobility issues stays upstairs.

The space
The downstairs has two bedrooms, a full bath, living room, dining room, kitchen, and a laundry room that connects to a staircase to the upstairs. There are also exterior stairs to the upstairs. 

Exterior steps lead to a balcony that overlooks the backyard and offers another entrance to the upstairs where we have another kitchen, 3 bedrooms, and bathroom. 

Across the backyard is another suite with its own seating area, bed, full bathroom, and kitchenette sink.
